title: Karla Turner and her family as alien and MILAB abductees

tellings.quote: made Turner unique was that she was an abductee and her family.

plain: The researcher and author Karla Turner, who wrote the books Taken and Into the Fringe, was herself an abductee, and so was her family, taken both by aliens and, it is said, in military abductions, known as MILABs, in which humans in uniform seize abductees. The filmmaker Tim Alberino tells this, setting her beside other abduction researchers such as Budd Hopkins and the hypnotherapist Barbara Bartholic, and says that being an abductee herself is what made Turner unique.
